cli.name: luuna-atlas

options.name: allow-unknown-types
options.description: tolerate on-disk records of unregistered types (worktree/CI lag escape hatch)

options.name: allow-domain-mismatch
options.description: tolerate records that violate per-domain allowed_types/required_fields (escape hatch for record/validate; ignored by sync)

options.name: format
options.description: output format for record-rendering commands (prime, query, search)

cli.help:
Luuna Atlas v0.11.0 — Structured expertise management

Usage: luuna-atlas <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                Initialize .luuna/atlas/ in the current project
  add <domain>        Add a new expertise domain
  record [options] <domain> [content]  Record an expertise record
  edit [options] <domain> <id>  Edit an existing expertise record
  query [options] [domain]  Query expertise records
  setup [options] [provider]  Set up luuna-atlas integration for a specific agent provider
  prime [options] [domains...]  Generate a priming prompt from expertise records
  hook                Claude Code PreToolUse handler (installed by `luuna-atlas setup claude`): injects file-anchored records, denies hand edits of .luuna/atlas/expertise/*.jsonl; reads hook JSON on stdin
  onboard [options]   Generate or update a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md snippet pointing to luuna-atlas prime
  status              Show status of expertise records
  validate            Validate expertise records against schemas
  prune [options]     Soft-archive (default) or hard-delete stale records, plus tier-demote superseded ones
  archive [options] <domain> [id]  Soft-archive one or more live records (symmetric to `luuna-atlas restore`; pairs with `luuna-atlas prune` for bulk decay)
  restore <id>        Restore a soft-archived record from .luuna/atlas/archive/ back to live expertise
  search [options] [query]  Search expertise records across domains
  show <ids...>       Show full record bodies by ID (the detail behind `luuna-atlas prime`'s index)
  stale [domains...]  List records that look stale: anchors changed since the evidence commit, missing anchors, or past shelf life unconfirmed
  rank [options] [domain]  Rank records by confirmation-frequency score (highest first)
  outcome [options] <domain> <id>  Append an outcome to an existing expertise record
  doctor [options]    Run health checks on expertise records
  ready [options]     Show recently added or updated expertise records
  sync [options]      Validate, stage, and commit .luuna/atlas/ changes
  delete [options] <domain> [id]  Delete an expertise record or multiple records in bulk
  delete-domain [options] <domain>  Delete an expertise domain and its expertise file
  move [options] <source-domain> <id> <target-domain>  Move a record from one domain to another, preserving its ID and metadata
  learn [options]     Show changed files and suggest domains for recording learnings
  compact [options] [domain]  Compact records: analyze candidates or apply a compaction
  config              Read and write .luuna/atlas/config.yaml
  diff [options]      Show expertise record changes since a git ref
  upgrade [options]   Upgrade Luuna Atlas after publication
  completions <shell>  Output shell completion script (bash, zsh, fish)
  audit [options]     Audit corpus health (evidence coverage, rule density, floaters, per-domain mix)

Options:
  -v, --version       Print version
  --json              Output as structured JSON
  -q, --quiet         Suppress non-error output
  --verbose           Show full details in output
  --timing            Print execution time to stderr
  --allow-unknown-types  tolerate on-disk records of unregistered types (worktree/CI lag escape hatch)
  --allow-domain-mismatch  tolerate records that violate per-domain allowed_types/required_fields (escape hatch for record/validate; ignored by sync)
  --format <format>   output format for record-rendering commands (prime, query, search) (choices: "markdown", "compact", "xml", "plain")
  -h, --help          display help for command

Run 'luuna-atlas <command> --help' for command-specific help.

commands.help:
record v0.11.0 — Structured expertise management

Usage: record <command> [options]

Options:
  --type <type>       record type (choices: "convention", "pattern", "failure", "decision", "reference", "guide")
  --classification <classification>  classification level (choices: "foundational", "tactical", "observational", default: "tactical")
  --name <name>       name of the convention or pattern
  --content <content>  content for convention records (explicit flag wins over positional [content])
  --description <description>  description of the record
  --resolution <resolution>  resolution for failure records
  --title <title>     title for decision records
  --rationale <rationale>  rationale for decision records
  --files <files>     related files (comma-separated)
  --dir-anchor <path>  repo-relative directory the record applies to (repeatable; auto-populated from changed files when omitted) (default: [])
  --tags <tags>       comma-separated tags
  --evidence-commit <commit>  evidence: commit hash (auto-populated from git if omitted)
  --evidence-issue <issue>  evidence: issue reference
  --evidence-file <file>  evidence: file path
  --evidence-bead <bead>  evidence: bead ID
  --evidence-missions <id>  evidence: missions issue ID
  --evidence-gh <ref>  evidence: GitHub issue or PR reference
  --evidence-linear <ticket>  evidence: Linear ticket reference
  --relates-to <ids>  comma-separated record IDs this relates to
  --supersedes <ids>  comma-separated record IDs this supersedes
  --outcome-status <status>  outcome status (choices: "success", "failure", "partial")
  --outcome-duration <ms>  outcome duration in milliseconds
  --outcome-test-results <text>  outcome test results summary
  --outcome-agent <agent>  outcome agent name
  --force             force recording even if duplicate exists
  --stdin             read JSON record(s) from stdin (single object or array)
  --batch <file>      read JSON record(s) from file (single object or array)
  --dry-run           preview what would be recorded without writing
  -h, --help          display help for command

Run 'record <command> --help' for command-specific help.

Required fields per record type:
  convention   --content (or positional [content])
  pattern      --name, --description (or [content])
  failure      --description, --resolution
  decision     --title, --rationale
  reference    --name, --description (or [content])
  guide        --name, --description (or [content])

--description alone works for every type except failure (needs --resolution):
it fills convention content, a derived pattern/reference/guide name, and a
decision title (first sentence) + rationale. Explicit flags win.

Batch recording examples:
  luuna-atlas record cli --batch records.json
  luuna-atlas record cli --batch records.json --dry-run
  echo '[{"type":"convention","content":"test"}]' > batch.json && luuna-atlas record cli --batch batch.json

Options:

commands.name: config
commands.description: Read and write .luuna/atlas/config.yaml
commands.help:
config v0.11.0 — Structured expertise management

Usage: config <command> [options]

Commands:
  schema              Emit AtlasConfig JSON Schema for schema-driven configuration UIs
  show [options]      Emit the effective AtlasConfig as JSON. Pass --path to read a single knob; falls back to the schema default when the knob is unset.
  set <path> <value>  Set a config knob via dot-notation path. <value> is YAML-parsed (so booleans, numbers, lists, and objects all work uniformly). The full resulting config is validated against the schema before atomic write under a file lock; invalid values are rejected with a schema-referenced error. Last-writer-wins semantics under concurrent writes — re-read via `luuna-atlas config show` after every write.
  unset <path>        Remove a config knob via dot-notation path so subsequent reads fall back to the schema default. Empty parent objects along the unset path are pruned when the schema allows the parent to be omitted; required-field removals are rejected with a schema-referenced error (use `luuna-atlas config set` to override). Idempotent — unsetting a never-set path is a silent no-op. Atomic write under a file lock.
  help [command]      display help for command

Options:
  -h, --help          display help for command

Run 'config <command> --help' for command-specific help.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a config knob via dot-notation path. <value> is YAML-parsed (so booleans, numbers, lists, and objects all work uniformly). The full resulting config is validated against the schema before atomic write under a file lock; invalid values are rejected with a schema-referenced error. Last-writer-wins semantics under concurrent writes — re-read via `luuna-atlas config show` after every write.
commands.help:
set v0.11.0 — Structured expertise management

Usage: set <command> [options]

Options:
  -h, --help          display help for command

Run 'set <command> --help' for command-specific help.

commands.name: unset
commands.description: Remove a config knob via dot-notation path so subsequent reads fall back to the schema default. Empty parent objects along the unset path are pruned when the schema allows the parent to be omitted; required-field removals are rejected with a schema-referenced error (use `luuna-atlas config set` to override). Idempotent — unsetting a never-set path is a silent no-op. Atomic write under a file lock.

configSchema.title: Atlas Configuration
configSchema.description: Schema for .luuna/atlas/config.yaml. Mirrors the AtlasConfig TypeScript interface in src/schemas/config.ts. Consumers (e.g. the Luuna desktop) render generic configuration UIs against this schema via `luuna-atlas config schema --json`.

version.title: Config version
version.description: Schema version of the on-disk config. Bumped only when the shape changes in a backwards-incompatible way.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Per-domain configuration keyed by domain name. Empty object is valid (a fresh project starts with no declared domains; `luuna-atlas record` auto-creates them).

additionalProperties.title: Domain configuration
additionalProperties.description: Per-domain rules. Empty/missing fields preserve back-compat (any registered type accepted, no extra required fields).

allowed_types.title: Allowed record types
allowed_types.description: Gates `--type` on write for this domain. Empty/missing means all registered types are allowed. `disabled_types` wins over `allowed_types` on overlap so retiring a type does not hard-fail peers.

required_fields.title: Required top-level fields
required_fields.description: Additional top-level fields every record in this domain must carry, on top of the per-type schema requirements.

governance.title: Governance limits
governance.description: Per-domain record-count thresholds. Atlas warns at `warn_entries` and refuses writes past `hard_limit` (configurable per project).

max_entries.title: Soft target
max_entries.description: Soft target for records per domain. Status reports flag domains above this number; writes are not blocked.

warn_entries.title: Warn threshold
warn_entries.description: Threshold at which `luuna-atlas record` prints a 'consider compacting' warning.

hard_limit.title: Hard limit
hard_limit.description: Maximum records per domain. Writes past this number are refused.

classification_defaults.title: Classification defaults
classification_defaults.description: Shelf-life windows (in days) for time-bound record classifications.

shelf_life.title: Shelf life (days)
shelf_life.description: How long records of each classification remain in primary expertise before `luuna-atlas prune` considers them stale. `foundational` records are permanent and are not listed here.

tactical.title: Tactical shelf life
tactical.description: Days a tactical record remains live before becoming prune-eligible.

observational.title: Observational shelf life
observational.description: Days an observational record remains live before becoming prune-eligible.

prime.title: Prime defaults
prime.description: Defaults applied when `luuna-atlas prime` is invoked without overriding flags.

default_mode.title: Default prime mode
default_mode.description: `full` (the default) emits the budget-capped record index, failures first; `manifest` emits a quick reference + per-domain counts instead of records.

tier_weights.title: Trust-tier ranking weights
tier_weights.description: Per-record sort score = stars * `star` + classification weight. Override only the knobs you want to retune; unset fields keep their default. Higher scores surface first.

star.title: Star weight
star.description: Multiplier applied to a record's confirmation-score (★ count from outcomes).

foundational.title: Foundational weight
foundational.description: Base score added to every foundational record.

tactical.title: Tactical weight
tactical.description: Base score added to every tactical record.

observational.title: Observational weight
observational.description: Base score added to every observational record.

session_close.title: Session-close footer
session_close.description: Footer appended after `luuna-atlas prime` (and the embedded snippet emitted by `luuna-atlas setup` / `luuna-atlas onboard`). `style` selects a built-in preset; `custom` overrides the preset with verbatim prose.

style.title: Preset style
style.description: `directive` = numbered imperative + type glossary + anti-filler guardrails. `conditional` = the v0.10.0 'if you discovered…' reframe (default). `minimal` = one-line nudge. `none` = suppress the footer entirely.

custom.title: Custom override
custom.description: Verbatim prose to emit in place of the preset. Wins over `style` when both are set; the embedded variant (used by `luuna-atlas setup` / `luuna-atlas onboard`) is also overridden.

search.title: Search tuning
search.description: Knobs that tune `luuna-atlas search` / `luuna-atlas rank` ranking.

boost_factor.title: Confirmation boost factor
boost_factor.description: Multiplier applied to BM25 scores via `applyConfirmationBoost`. 0 disables the boost.

custom_types.title: Custom record types
custom_types.description: Project-defined record types keyed by type name. Treated identically to built-ins by the registry (CLI flags, validation, dedup, formatters).

additionalProperties.title: Custom record type
additionalProperties.description: Definition of a custom record type. May extend a built-in to inherit its required/optional fields, dedup_key, id_key, summary, compact strategy, section title, and file-extraction behavior — override only what differs; arrays merge as a union. Custom-from-custom is not supported.

extends.title: Built-in to extend
extends.description: Name of a built-in type (convention, pattern, failure, decision, reference, guide). Custom-from-custom is rejected.

required.title: Required fields
required.description: Top-level fields a record of this type must carry.

optional.title: Optional fields
optional.description: Additional top-level fields a record of this type may carry.

dedup_key.title: Dedup key
dedup_key.description: Field used to detect duplicates on write (e.g. 'name' or 'content').

id_key.title: Display ID field
id_key.description: Field used to render a record's identifying label in compact output.

summary.title: Summary template
summary.description: Compact-line summary template used by `luuna-atlas prime`.

extracts_files.title: Extracts files
extracts_files.description: Whether records of this type carry a list of file anchors.

files_field.title: Files field name
files_field.description: Field name that holds file anchors when extracts_files is true (e.g. 'files').

compact.title: Compact strategy
compact.description: How `luuna-atlas compact` collapses duplicates of this type.

section_title.title: Section title
section_title.description: Heading used when grouping this type in `luuna-atlas prime` output.

aliases.title: Field aliases
aliases.description: Map canonical (current) field name to legacy aliases. Records on disk that carry a legacy field are rewritten to the canonical name at read time.

decay.title: Decay knobs
decay.description: Configuration for tier-demotion behavior in `luuna-atlas prune`. Currently only `anchor_validity` is wired; `weight` is reserved for the future fitness blend.

anchor_validity.title: Anchor-validity decay
anchor_validity.description: Tier-demotion knobs for `luuna-atlas prune --check-anchors`. A record decays one tier per pass when its file/dir anchors stop resolving and `valid_fraction` drops below `threshold`, provided the record is older than `grace_days`. Records with zero anchors are exempt (absence means 'applies globally').

threshold.title: Validity threshold
threshold.description: Demote when the fraction of resolving anchors drops below this value. Range: [0, 1].

grace_days.title: Grace period (days)
grace_days.description: Records younger than this many days are exempt from anchor-validity decay so brand-new records can stabilize.

weight.title: Fitness weight
weight.description: Reserved for the future fitness blend (R-05g). Currently unused; safe to leave unset.

audit.title: Audit configuration
audit.description: Knobs for `luuna-atlas audit`. Global thresholds are merged on top of defaults; per-domain entries layer on top of the global thresholds for that domain only.

thresholds.title: Audit thresholds
thresholds.description: PASS/WARN/FAIL bands for `luuna-atlas audit`. Below `_warn` is FAIL; between `_warn` and the primary threshold is WARN; meeting the primary threshold is PASS. Floater and stale knobs use a single PASS ceiling.

evidence_coverage.title: Evidence coverage (PASS)
evidence_coverage.description: PASS when ≥ this fraction of records carry any tracker (missions/gh/linear/bead) or commit evidence. Range: [0, 1].

evidence_coverage_warn.title: Evidence coverage (WARN)
evidence_coverage_warn.description: WARN when evidence coverage is between this value and `evidence_coverage`. Below this is FAIL. Range: [0, 1].

floater_max.title: Floater rate (PASS ceiling)
floater_max.description: PASS when the fraction of records without any tracker, relates_to, or commit evidence is ≤ this value. Above is WARN/FAIL.

rule_density_min.title: Convention rule-density (PASS)
rule_density_min.description: PASS when ≥ this fraction of convention records contain a rule-signal word (because, must not, avoid, always, never, …). Range: [0, 1].

rule_density_warn.title: Convention rule-density (WARN)
rule_density_warn.description: WARN when rule-density is between this value and `rule_density_min`. Below this is FAIL. Range: [0, 1].

max_records_per_domain.title: Records per domain (PASS ceiling)
max_records_per_domain.description: Informational ceiling on records per domain; auditors flag domains above this number. Distinct from `governance.hard_limit` which gates writes.

max_stale.title: Stale records (PASS ceiling)
max_stale.description: Informational ceiling on stale (past-shelf-life) records per domain. PASS when ≤ this value.

ignore_domains.title: Domains excluded from audit
ignore_domains.description: Domains skipped entirely by `luuna-atlas audit` (e.g. reference-doc domains that are legitimately convention-heavy and evidence-light).

per_domain.title: Per-domain threshold overrides
per_domain.description: Threshold overrides keyed by domain name. Partial overrides are merged on top of the global thresholds; keys not declared inherit the global value.

additionalProperties.title: Audit thresholds
additionalProperties.description: PASS/WARN/FAIL bands for `luuna-atlas audit`. Below `_warn` is FAIL; between `_warn` and the primary threshold is WARN; meeting the primary threshold is PASS. Floater and stale knobs use a single PASS ceiling.

evidence_coverage.title: Evidence coverage (PASS)
evidence_coverage.description: PASS when ≥ this fraction of records carry any tracker (missions/gh/linear/bead) or commit evidence. Range: [0, 1].

evidence_coverage_warn.title: Evidence coverage (WARN)
evidence_coverage_warn.description: WARN when evidence coverage is between this value and `evidence_coverage`. Below this is FAIL. Range: [0, 1].

floater_max.title: Floater rate (PASS ceiling)
floater_max.description: PASS when the fraction of records without any tracker, relates_to, or commit evidence is ≤ this value. Above is WARN/FAIL.

rule_density_min.title: Convention rule-density (PASS)
rule_density_min.description: PASS when ≥ this fraction of convention records contain a rule-signal word (because, must not, avoid, always, never, …). Range: [0, 1].

rule_density_warn.title: Convention rule-density (WARN)
rule_density_warn.description: WARN when rule-density is between this value and `rule_density_min`. Below this is FAIL. Range: [0, 1].

max_records_per_domain.title: Records per domain (PASS ceiling)
max_records_per_domain.description: Informational ceiling on records per domain; auditors flag domains above this number. Distinct from `governance.hard_limit` which gates writes.

max_stale.title: Stale records (PASS ceiling)
max_stale.description: Informational ceiling on stale (past-shelf-life) records per domain. PASS when ≤ this value.

quality.title: Record quality gate
quality.description: Write-time checks on `luuna-atlas record`: near-duplicates, conventions/patterns with no anchor or evidence, conventions that restate code. `level`: `warn` (default) prints and writes, `error` blocks unless --force, `off` skips. Exact duplicates are always blocked.

disabled_types.title: Disabled types
disabled_types.description: Names of registered types (built-in or custom) that emit a deprecation warning on write. Reads still succeed; the type stays in CLI choices.

hooks.title: Lifecycle hooks
hooks.description: Ordered shell scripts invoked at each lifecycle event. Scripts receive the payload as JSON on stdin (with LUUNA_ATLAS_HOOK=1; cwd at project root). `pre-*` hooks block on non-zero exit; `post-*` hooks emit a warning. `pre-record`, `pre-prime`, and `pre-compact` may mutate the payload via stdout JSON; `pre-prune` is block-or-allow only.

pre-record.description: Ordered shell commands invoked for this lifecycle event.

post-record.description: Ordered shell commands invoked for this lifecycle event.

pre-prime.description: Ordered shell commands invoked for this lifecycle event.

pre-prune.description: Ordered shell commands invoked for this lifecycle event.

pre-compact.description: Ordered shell commands invoked for this lifecycle event.

timeout_ms.title: Hook timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Maximum runtime per hook script. SIGKILL on timeout. Default is 5000ms.
